findings.title: A .git file stops the fingerprint walk and admits transient copy bytes
findings.diagnosis: Fingerprint returns filepath.SkipDir for .git without checking whether it is a directory. For a Git gitdir file, WalkDir skips the remaining entries in its parent directory. Gitfile repositories are accepted for non-git criterion checks. A writer can edit an existing tracked file after fpBefore, let Materialize copy that file, and restore it before the final Snapshot and Fingerprint. Both guards then equal their initial values while the private copy contains unreviewed bytes. This violates the exact-reviewed-target prerequisite for positive criterion credit. Host and core locks do not lock repository writers.

evidence.observation: The .git case returns SkipDir for every file type.
The only live-copy consistency checks are before/after Snapshot and Fingerprint around captureOnTarget.
All 3 ordinary and all 5 race-enabled gitfile repetitions report snapshot_equal=true fingerprint_equal=true materialized="UNREVIEWED\n". Every .git-directory control reports fingerprint_equal=false.
The real host fixture binds a gitfile repository, imports an isolated pass report, and reaches the sandbox probe for a non-git check.

findings.observed_limit: No criterion executable was run unconfined. Materialize and the acceptance guards were reproduced directly. A PASSED append exploiting this gap is inferred from caller wiring, not observed, because bubblewrap cannot start here.

fix.action: In Fingerprint, return filepath.SkipDir only when the .git entry is a directory. Return nil for the excluded .git file or symlink so traversal continues to its siblings. Add regression coverage for accepted gitdir-file repositories and transient changes during the materialization window.
fix.why: WalkDir uses SkipDir on a non-directory to skip its remaining siblings. Continuing the walk restores the file-metadata evidence on which credit relies.

verification.method: Run TestAuditorGitfileTransientCopy repeatedly and under -race after the change. Add a no-writer reviewed-byte copy control.
verification.expected: Every transient gitfile edit changes the fingerprint or refuses credit. The no-writer copy contains REVIEWED bytes and its guard remains equal.

verification.method: On a host with bubblewrap, bind a gitfile repository and import a pass review for a check that only succeeds on transient unreviewed tracked bytes. Schedule the writer around Materialize.
verification.expected: No run records PASSED. An unchanged reviewed target can still credit.

fix.tradeoffs: The minimal fix preserves Git gitdir-file support. Metadata-based detection still depends on the supported filesystem semantics. It does not prevent writers.
fix.alternative: Refuse non-directory .git entries before all criterion checks, including non-git commands. This is a simpler containment policy but rejects linked worktrees and separate-git-dir checkouts. A content-verified immutable materialization would provide a stronger boundary at greater implementation cost.

findings.title: Overlap refusal omits directory mounts in systemFiles
findings.diagnosis: sandboxCommand rejects live roots under systemDirs, then binds all existing systemFiles entries without that check. systemFiles contains directories: /etc/ssl, /etc/alternatives, and /etc/ld.so.conf.d. A repository rooted within one of these directories would remain readable beside the private target. A read-only bind prevents writes but still exposes ignored or other unreviewed live inputs. The generic live-path string check does not cover aliases or computed paths.

evidence.observation: The overlap list is systemDirs, while the bind list also includes systemFiles directories.
/usr/share is rejected as a system-directory overlap. Each of the 3 /etc directory cases reaches the probe instead; all 3 race-enabled repetitions reproduce the omission.

findings.observed_limit: The policy function was tested against existing directory paths. No repository was created in /etc and no system file was changed. Actual mount visibility and false credit on a functioning sandbox are inferred from bind arguments and remain unverified here.

fix.action: Validate repository overlap against the resolved source of every planned bind mount before the probe. Include systemFiles entries that are directories. Reject a mount whose directory contains the live root or exposes a subtree of it. Keep the executable-tree overlap check and test symlink spellings.
fix.why: All host paths exposed by the sandbox must be subject to the same live-repository separation rule; the variable name systemFiles is not a filesystem-type check.

verification.method: Extend TestAuditorMountedDirectoryOverlap with the existing /etc directories, a live /etc ancestor case, and symlink aliases. Keep /usr/share and an ordinary home/tmp checkout control.
verification.expected: Every live-directory overlap is refused before the bubblewrap probe. The ordinary checkout reaches the probe.

verification.method: On a functioning sandbox host, create an isolated fixture under an approved writable mounted-source directory and attempt to read an ignored live input through an alias.
verification.expected: Policy refuses before any criterion starts. No ignored live input produces PASSED.

fix.tradeoffs: Refusal limits repositories in runtime dependency directories. Replacing whole-directory binds with a minimal runtime image is broader and may affect toolchain compatibility.
fix.alternative: Use a fixed minimal runtime image or selectively hide the live subtree after binding dependencies. This avoids some location restrictions but adds mount-order and dependency complexity. Fail-closed overlap refusal is the smaller change.
